title: rag.py audit lists the open _gaps.md entries whose question the kb's own pack already answers
goal: rag.py audit --stale-gaps runs the pack for each open gap entry's question and lists the entries whose pack is good with a cited line in another article than the gap's notes, so a gap sweep closes stale entries without a model; found 2026-11-09 when 9 of 15 gaps a research run chose were already answered (commit b7e486fe8)
notes: 2026-11-09 gaps2 sweep: 60/60 open gaps packed good on the kb's own UNK not-stated lines and none was closable from the pack; the audit must skip UNK lines and lines inside the gap's own article that say not stated (see the false-good bug filed the same day).
